Frost Bank is a $53.0B in assets regional bank regulated by TX DOB + Federal Reserve + FDIC, operating since 1977 with 5,059 employees. A 5.1% multi-year growth rate and a trajectory the analyst classifies as accelerating give it the balance sheet to fund transformation [E-021, E-033]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 2.1/5. The deepest capability gap is Experience Measurement (NPS/CSAT) at 1.8/5 against a 2.5 peer median [E-076]. Next is Data Residency & Sovereignty Controls at 1.9/5 against a 2.5 peer median [E-077, E-164].

Third is Delivery Optimization at 1.9/5 against a 2.0 peer median [E-134]. The issue register adds =2.24<2.5 but 6 P3 subcaps >3.0 (high severity). The issue register adds Report has 22 unique E-IDs (target ≥30). Exec: 10. All 4 pillars + 10 recs cite evidence.

Prose integration vs inline.. The roster shows no CDO — a named ownership gap for the capabilities below. The question for Frost Bank is whether to close Experience Measurement (NPS/CSAT) first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. Frost Bank should lead with nCino (76/100 fit) against Idea Sourcing Channels, then sequence Tableau behind it. Closing Experience Measurement (NPS/CSAT) to the peer median alone is worth 0.7 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain.
